verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should, with a clear headline. But the 'Find It Near You' CTA is tiny, no bigger than the two badges, and buried in a row of three pills; the body copy is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column; and the can is shrunk to an icon. B has more serious problems: the can and circle are cropped off the left edge; the SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline; the body copy is tiny; the CTA and badges form a ragged, cramped stack on the far right; and a big empty gap sits in the middle.
